name: Every Link Remembered
method: Installed built-in image generator supplied the motif; Node built-ins removed white in memory and composited pigment only in vacant rock. Generated motif overwritten by final wall.

visual_review.pepe: Inherited wide mouth and heavy-lidded eyes preserved unchanged
visual_review.digits: Both inherited Pepe hands and the hand stencil retain five digits each; no new hands
visual_review.forbidden_marks: No letters, numbers, captions, signatures, logos, watermarks, borders, frames, real people or prohibited symbols observed
visual_review.limitations: The new mark is small and subdued at thumbnail size; inherited rock texture retained as supplied. Local review only.
